page.overview:
Who is Secret Characters?

Secret characters are special individuals who are usually not found within the original 1P and 2P Tournament/Battle Plan or readily available for play on the outset. To reach them, one must meet specific conditions, often challenging ones in order to face them in kombat. Secret characters often appear as color palette swaps (usually ninjas) of existing characters with enhanced speed and powers. Mortal Kombat is exceptional, if not well-known, for being the first game to introduce secret characters in fighting games, and since then, has become a very recurring trend in the genre. For the most part, secret characters are unplayable and merely exist to challenge the player.

However, in MK3 and its updates and ports, secret characters can be unlocked for player control via the Ultimate Kombat Kode (UKK), consisting of 10 slots. If any one of the kodes are input successfully, an animation will play where arenas will quickly flash by in succession before displaying the character that was unlocked according to the code announcing, FROM THIS POINT ON, I AM AT YOUR CONTROL. Similar to regular Kombat Kodes, Ultimate Kombat Kodes require inputs from both players.

All secret characters fought here are fought at Goro's Lair from the first game.

In a tribute to MK's history, secret characters make their return for this installment as the original incarnations as they first appeared. Although limited in movesets and lacking Super Meters, they have greater stamina, speed and sometimes, special abilities.
